## Features

| Feature | Included |
| --- | --- |
| **Capture** | Regions, windows and accessible app elements |
| **Annotate** | Pen, shapes, arrows, text, numbers and editable objects |
| **Redact** | Mosaic, blur and opaque black box |
| **Pin** | Floating images and animated GIFs, zoom, opacity and groups |
| **OCR** | Select a text region; recognize Korean and English locally |
| **GIF** | 5–30 fps, resolution / duration controls, preview, copy, pin and save |

UI: 한국어 · English · 日本語 · 简体中文. [Feature limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/FEATURES.md) · [Manual & optional automatic updates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/AUTO-UPDATE.md) from 1.1.0. Install 1.1.0 manually once if upgrading from 1.0.0.

## Install

1. Download the DMG for **Apple Silicon (arm64)** or **Intel (x86_64)** from [Releases](https://github.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/releases/latest).
2. Open the DMG and drag **Promecapt.app** onto **Applications**, then eject the disk image.
3. Open the app; enable **Screen Recording** and **Accessibility** when needed.

**Not notarized yet.** If macOS blocks a trusted download, follow the [installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/INSTALL.md). Local builds need no paid Apple Developer account.

## Shortcuts

| Action | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Capture | `⌥⌘1` |
| Copy / pin capture | `⌘C` / `⌘Enter` |
| Pin clipboard | `⌥⌘3` |
| Show / hide pins | `⌥⌘4` |
| Previous / next capture | `,` / `.` |
| Cancel / close pin | `Esc` |

Customize shortcuts, including F1, in Settings → Shortcuts. Use `Fn+F1` in media-key mode.

## Build from source

Requires free Apple Command Line Tools and Swift 5.9+. No paid developer account or signing certificate.

```sh
xcode-select --install # complete the installer before continuing
git clone --branch v1.1.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/PROMLEE/promecapt.git
cd promecapt
bash scripts/package.sh
mkdir -p "$HOME/Applications"
ditto dist/Promecapt.app "$HOME/Applications/Promecapt.app"
open "$HOME/Applications/Promecapt.app"
```

Local processing; no uploads or analytics. History includes full display snapshots. [Storage & privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/USAGE.md#privacy--storage).

# Install Promecapt without an Apple Developer account

**You do not need a paid Apple Developer account to build and run Promecapt on your own Mac.** Developer ID signing and notarization affect how macOS verifies a downloaded app; their absence does not mean that the app can only run on its author's computer.

Choose either a local source build or a prebuilt DMG or ZIP. Both still need the macOS permissions used by a screen-capture app. Company-managed Macs may restrict either option; check with your IT administrator if policy blocks installation.

[한국어 설치 가이드](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/INSTALL.ko.md) · [English README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/README.md) · [日本語](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/README.ja.md#ソースからビルド) · [简体中文](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/README.zh-CN.md#从源码构建)

## Option A — Build locally, with free Apple tools

### 1. Install the command-line tools

Open Terminal and run:

```sh
xcode-select --install
```

Finish Apple's installer before continuing. If the tools are already installed, macOS may simply report that fact. A paid developer membership, signing certificate and App Store Connect credentials are not needed.

Verify your compiler:

```sh
swift --version
```

Use **Swift 5.9 or newer**. The app runs on macOS 13+, but building requires a macOS / Command Line Tools combination that supplies a compatible compiler. Update your available Apple tools or macOS if the compiler is too old. Full Xcode is optional for packaging; it is required for the XCTest command `swift test`.

### 2. Download the released source and build the app

Run these commands in the folder where you want to keep the source:

```sh
git clone --branch v1.1.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/PROMLEE/promecapt.git
cd promecapt
bash scripts/package.sh
```

This produces `dist/Promecapt.app` and a ZIP for your Mac's CPU. The script uses a local **ad-hoc signature** by default. It does not need an Apple Developer login, certificate, private key or signing secret. Swift Package Manager downloads the pinned Sparkle updater framework.

This is a source build, not an Apple-notarized build. It does not override an employer's device policy or other macOS access controls.

### 3. Install in your own Applications folder

Quit any existing Promecapt instance before replacing it. The following destination is your personal Applications folder and does not require administrator access:

```sh
mkdir -p "$HOME/Applications"
ditto dist/Promecapt.app "$HOME/Applications/Promecapt.app"
open "$HOME/Applications/Promecapt.app"
```

You can instead move the app to `/Applications` in Finder if you have permission. Use **one installation at a stable path** so permissions attach to the app you actually launch. For normal use, launch the packaged `.app`, rather than `swift run` or the executable inside `.build`.

### 4. Allow capture and element detection

1. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording** (or **Screen & System Audio Recording** on newer macOS).
2. Enable **Promecapt**, then quit and reopen the app if requested.
3. Enable **Promecapt** under **Accessibility** for app-element detection and enhanced global shortcuts.
4. Use the capture-frame icon in the menu bar. The default capture shortcut is `⌥⌘1`; select the F1 preset in Settings → Shortcuts if desired.

Dock visibility can be off while the app keeps running. Reopen the app from Applications to open settings.

## Option B — Use a prebuilt release

1. Download from the [official Releases page](https://github.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/releases): `arm64` for Apple Silicon, `x86_64` for Intel.
2. Compare the downloaded file's SHA-256 with its accompanying `.sha256` file. For example, run `shasum -a 256 Promecapt-1.1.0-macos-arm64.dmg` in the download folder and compare the first hash value.
3. **DMG (recommended):** open it and drag **Promecapt.app** onto **Applications** in the installation window. Eject the disk image and launch the installed app from Applications. **ZIP:** unzip and move the app to Applications manually.
4. The current release is ad-hoc signed and **not Developer ID signed or notarized**. If macOS blocks an unidentified / unnotarized app, review the source and checksum first. If you trust this exact app, follow [Apple's per-app opening procedure](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445): after attempting to open it, use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**, then confirm the app in the prompt.
5. Complete the capture permissions above.

A warning that software is damaged or contains malware is not the same as an unidentified-developer warning. Stop and check the download / contact the maintainer in that case. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally or remove security controls to install Promecapt. Managed devices may not offer a per-app exception.

The DMG is a drag-to-install container, not an automatic installer. It does not change signing or notarization status. ZIP downloads remain available.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| `xcode-select` opens an installer | Finish the installer, then rerun `swift --version`. |
| Compiler is older than Swift 5.9 | Update compatible Apple command-line tools / macOS before building. |
| App is running but there is no Dock icon | Use the menu bar icon, or reopen the `.app` to reach settings. |
| F1 changes brightness | Use `Fn+F1`, change macOS function-key behavior, or choose another shortcut. |
| Screen capture is denied even though its switch is on | Quit the app. A new ad-hoc build may need its permission refreshed: remove only the existing Promecapt entry in System Settings, use + to add the exact installed `.app`, then relaunch. macOS may require Touch ID or password authentication. Leave unrelated apps' permissions untouched. |
| Internal buttons / text fields are not detected | Check Accessibility permission. Detection also depends on what the target app exposes. |
| A company Mac blocks the app | Ask IT about approved installation / local compilation. Local builds do not bypass organization policy. |

## Build checks and updates

`bash scripts/test-local.sh` runs local checks using Command Line Tools; `swift test` additionally requires full Xcode. The release is tested on both Apple Silicon and Intel in CI.

From 1.1.0, use Settings → About → Check for Updates, or opt in to automatic download, installation and relaunch. Version 1.0.0 needs one manual installation of 1.1.0. You can also quit the app and replace it with a newer official build, or build a newer reviewed release tag at the same installation path. Keep your library; do not delete application data just to refresh a permission.

# Using Promecapt

## Quick start

| Action | Default shortcut / gesture |
| --- | --- |
| Capture a region or window | `⌥⌘1`, then drag or click an automatically detected target |
| Copy capture / pin capture | `⌘C` / `⌘Enter` |
| Pin clipboard | `⌥⌘3` |
| Show / hide all pins | `⌥⌘4` |
| Browse older / newer captures | `,` / `.` during capture |
| Cancel capture / close a pin | `Esc` |
| Open settings | Menu bar icon → Settings, or `⌘,` while the app is active |
| Change stroke width / redaction strength | Scroll over the image, or use the numeric stepper |
| Move / zoom a pin | Drag / scroll |
| Change pin opacity | `Ctrl` + scroll |
| Edit a still-image pin in place | `Space`; use the selection tool to edit existing annotations |
| Record a GIF | Menu bar → Record GIF region, or the capture toolbar's GIF button |

Choose the **F1 / F3 / F4** preset or your own shortcuts in Settings → Shortcuts. In media-key mode, use `Fn+F1` or enable standard function keys in macOS. `Enter` confirms text; it does not finish a capture.

Settings → General selects your language and Dock visibility. Menu bar operation works with the Dock icon hidden.

## GIF recording

Settings → GIF offers **5–30 fps**, a **640 / 1280 / 1920 px long edge or original Retina pixels**, and **15 / 30 / 60 second** limits. The app never upscales the source. Static screens may produce fewer frames; recording also stops at 256 MiB of temporary frame files.

A red dashed border and light outside shading mark the recording region without blocking clicks. After stopping, the result window provides playback, **Copy**, **Pin** and **Save**. Copy includes original GIF data, a GIF attachment path and a PNG fallback; animation when pasted depends on the receiving app. Recording stays within one display, excludes Promecapt windows, and captures no audio. GIF annotation, rotation and frame editing are not supported yet.

## Privacy & storage

Capture, annotation and OCR processing happen locally. There is no account, upload service or analytics in the app.

History stores the selected image **and the full display snapshot with its selection position**, so browsing can restore the surrounding screen. Keep this in mind when capturing private material. The history limit and Clear History remove these backgrounds too; pins are stored separately.

Your preferences and library remain on this Mac. GIF clipboard attachments are cached locally and older copies expire when new copies are made.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/FEATURES.md

# Feature status — Promecapt 1.1.0

| Area | Included | Limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Capture | Region, window, accessible elements; eight handles; keyboard adjustment | Element detection varies by target app's accessibility support |
| Annotations | Pen, highlighter, shapes, arrows, text, numbers; explicit reselection | Flattened images cannot recover old annotation objects |
| Redaction | Mosaic, blur, opaque black box; numeric and wheel adjustment | Mosaic and blur are visual effects; choose opaque black box for complete coverage |
| Pins | Move, resize, opacity, groups, hide, click-through recovery, persisted annotations | Full-image transformations flatten still-image annotations |
| OCR | User-selected region, editable result, local Vision processing | Korean and English recognition; UI languages are separate |
| History | Comma / period traversal, full screen context and original selection | Old cropped-only entries use the current desktop background |
| GIF | Configurable fps, long edge, time limit and cursor; region overlay; preview, copy, animated pin, save | One display, no audio or Promecapt windows; no GIF annotation/rotation/frame editing; temporary-frame budget |
| Languages | Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese; automatic or manual choice | Existing editors use their creation-time language; native OS dialogs follow macOS |
| Distribution | Apple Silicon and Intel ZIP workflows; SHA-256 checksums; MIT | Initial distribution is ad-hoc signed and not notarized |
| Updates | Manual checks; optional automatic download, installation and relaunch via Sparkle | Stable releases only; 1.0.0 needs one manual installation; ad-hoc permissions may need refreshing |

See the [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/README.md), [testing guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/QA.md), and [release guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/docs/RELEASING.md) for operation and verification.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

# Contributing to Promecapt

Thank you for helping improve Promecapt. Small, focused changes and reproducible bug reports are welcome.

## Development

Use macOS 13+, Swift 5.9+ and Xcode Command Line Tools. Run `bash scripts/test-local.sh` before submitting a change. With full Xcode installed, also run `swift test`. Package with `bash scripts/package.sh` and test the resulting `.app`, since screen permissions attach to the app identity.

Keep pull requests focused on one behavior and describe the problem, resulting behavior and verification. GUI changes should be checked in both light and dark appearance, with the Dock icon hidden, and with English labels as well as Korean. Include screenshot fixtures containing synthetic content rather than personal screens.

## Translations

The UI catalog is `Sources/Promecapt/Resources/Translations.json`. Korean source strings are stable lookup keys; the catalog contains `en`, `ja` and `zh-Hans`. Keep every `{0}`, `{1}`, etc. placeholder exactly once wherever the source uses it. Translate the surrounding sentence freely. Run `python3 scripts/check-localization.py`.

Persisted `DrawingTool` and `ConcealStyle` raw values are data-format identifiers: do not translate or rename them. Localize their labels at the UI boundary. Keep all four READMEs aligned when changing installation steps, privacy behavior or supported features. Existing editors use their creation-time language; new windows and menus follow the selected language immediately.

## Documentation

Keep the four READMEs aligned and update the installation guides when build or permission steps change. Run `python3 scripts/generate-llms.py` after changing documentation, then `python3 scripts/check-docs.py`. The generated `llms.txt` index, `llm.txt` compatibility entry and `llms-full.txt` consolidated guide must stay in sync with their source files; CI checks freshness and repository links.

## Issues and security

Include app version, macOS version, CPU architecture, steps to reproduce, expected behavior and actual behavior. Screen captures can contain an entire display in their history context; remove private content before sharing files. Do not post credentials or signing keys. For sensitive security reports, see [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/SECURITY.md).

## License and assets

Contributions are provided under the project's MIT license. Only submit code and assets you have permission to contribute. Do not copy proprietary software code, icons or screenshots. The capture-frame mark is shared by `CaptureMark.swift` and the icon generator; keep its app and menu-bar variants visually consistent.


---

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PROMLEE/promecapt/main/SECURITY.md

# Security

Promecapt processes captures and OCR locally. History includes full display snapshots, and GIF clipboard copies use local cached attachment files. Screen Recording and Accessibility are sensitive permissions; never ask users to disable macOS security protections globally.

Do not post a security-sensitive capture, credential or exploit with private data in a public issue. Use the repository's private vulnerability reporting feature if available. Otherwise open an issue asking for a private reporting channel without including sensitive details.

The first release is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. Only download releases from this repository or build from reviewed source. Automatic update transport has not been implemented; the updater design is not a security guarantee for a feature that does not yet exist.
